title: SIDESTORY: EXODUS FROM THE PALE SEA RERUN
lines: 01 SIDESTORY: EXODUS FROM THE PALE SEA RERUN
UNLOCK REQUIREMENT: Clear Main Storyline 1-10
DETAILS: Exodus From The Pale Sea event stages will be open for a limited time. Players can obtain event rewards by clearing event stages, completing event missions, and redeeming from Event Store.
EVENT STAGE DURATION:
[Across the Salt Flat] & [Through the Skeletal Reef]
[Sailing Schedule]
DETAILS: During the event, players can complete [Sailing Schedule] missions by clearing event stages to gain rewards.
REWARDS: [★★★★★: Rose Salt], 'Cuna de Nene' Cabin Furniture (Pieces), Module Materials, [Saltfin Garum], etc.
[Salt Ship Marketplace]

DETAILS: During the event, players can obtain [Saltfin Garum] by clearing event stages and completing [Sailing Schedule] missions. [Saltfin Garum] can be used to redeem items from [Salt Ship Marketplace].
REWARDS: Rose Salt's token, 'Cuna de Nene' Cabin (Pieces), Headhunting Permit, Elite Materials, LMD, Battle Records, etc.
Note:

- For this rerun event, some of the engraved medals in the corresponding Engraved Medal Set will have their acquisition conditions adjusted. Players who meet the updated conditions will be able to obtain the event's engraved medals. Due to these adjustments, players who previously participated in the event and already meet the new acquisition conditions will receive the corresponding engraved medals immediately upon the update.
- After this rerun event ends, the engraved medals from the event's Engraved Medal Set cannot be obtained again through [Score] or any other channels.
- This rerun event is a lightweight rerun; event stages will inherit the player's previous event stage progress and first-time drop progress.

- Some non-repeatable event rewards during this rerun can be converted into [Intelligence Certificate] at a corresponding ratio when obtained again. The conversion rates can be found in the event's Intelligence Certificate Conversion Rules.
- The [Intelligence Certificate] shop will restock additional quantities of existing items and add new items when the event starts.
- Trust gain for Thorns the Lodestar, Tecno, and Rose Salt will be increased in the event stages of this rerun.
- After this event ends, the event stages will be permanently added to [Score] on June 19, 2026, at 04:00 (UTC-7).
02 LIMITED-TIME HEADHUNTING RERUN – CONFIRMATION, COMPLETION, CONDUCTION
DETAILS: During the event, the Limited-time Headhunting, [Confirmation, Completion, Conduction], opens and the following Operators will appear at a higher rate:
★★★★★★: Thorns the Lodestar
★★★★★: Tecno / Rockrock

Note: This is a [Standard Headhunting] that features the same Operators as the latest permanent [Standard Headhunting]. If you make 150 headhunting attempts without receiving the current rate-up 6-star Operator, the next 6-star Operator received is guaranteed to be the current rate-up 6-star Operator.
03 NEW ARRIVAL AT THE OUTFIT STORE
DETAILS: The following new Outfit will be available at the Outfit Store:
Achievement Star Collection - The Starting Point for Rose Salt
04 RE-EDITION OUTFITS AT THE OUTFIT STORE
DETAILS: The following Re-edition Outfits will be available at the Outfit Store, including:
Icefield Messenger Collection - Occasionally Flushed for Penance
Icefield Messenger Collection - Dance for Tsukinogi
Icefield Messenger Collection - Gratitude Gift for Qanipalaat
Icefield Messenger Collection - Inviting Snow for Harold
05 RE-EDITION FURNITURE SET – 'CUNA DE NENE' CABIN
DETAILS: This furniture set will be available again during the event.
HOW TO OBTAIN:
- Exodus from the Pale Sea event rewards and redeemable (Pieces)
- Limited-time sale at the Store (Pieces)
Please stay tuned for more information!
